title: vediyamānassa
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.
groupSub: The Nearest Cause for the Origination of dukkha

paras.en:
“Bhikkhus, it is for one who feels that I proclaim:
‘This is dukkha,’
I proclaim: ‘This is the origin of dukkha,’
I proclaim: ‘This is the cessation of dukkha,’
I proclaim: ‘This is the way leading to the cessation of dukkha.’”
